content:
Payslip Contribution Item

Define employer contribution items for payslips.

Contributions include items like retirement fund contributions or insurance premiums paid by the employer.

Name

Enter a descriptive name for this contribution item, such as 'Employer Superannuation' or 'Company Pension Contribution'.

Expense account

Select the expense account where employer contributions will be recorded. This is typically a payroll expense account.

Liability account

Select the liability account where unpaid contributions will be recorded until they are paid to the relevant authority or fund.

Reporting Category

Select a reporting category to group this contribution item for reporting purposes. This helps in analyzing contribution costs by category.

Inactive

Check this box to make the contribution item inactive. Inactive items won't appear in selection lists but remain in historical records.
